name: Dimensional Analysis
description: Systematic dimension tracking procedure for physics expressions

steps.action: Identify all symbols in the expression and their physical dimensions from research context
steps.checkpoint: Every symbol has a dimension assignment? Unknown symbols flagged?

steps.action: Construct dimension_map: {symbol_name: dimension_string} where dimension_string uses [M], [L], [T], [E] notation or natural-unit equivalents
steps.checkpoint: dimension_map is complete and consistent with natural_units convention lock? In natural units: mass [E], length [E⁻¹], time [E⁻¹]

steps.action: Run dimensional_check.py with the expression and dimension_map
steps.checkpoint: Script returns status: pass/fail/warning. No dimension_map → warning with confidence 0.3 (cannot verify)

steps.action: If script returns fail, investigate: wrong dimension assignment, algebraic error, or convention mismatch
steps.checkpoint: Root cause identified? Fix dimension_map or expression before proceeding

steps.action: Verify final expression has correct overall dimensions (e.g., cross section has [E⁻²] in natural units)
steps.checkpoint: Overall dimension matches expected physical quantity

red_flags: Expression with mixed natural/SI dimensions without explicit conversion
Dimensionless quantity that has non-zero computed dimensions
Dimensions that don't match known scaling behavior (e.g., wrong power of energy)
Missing ℏ or c factors in natural-unit expressions applied to dimensional quantities
Adding quantities with different dimensions (e.g., mass + length)
common_errors: E02: Metric signature affecting dimension signs
